player_prompt.intro:
Ove iwe Muthandi {player_id} ukina omuthindo wa Pig Dice.

Ovikwima:
- Pa nthanda yove, ove ikwame '[roll]' kana '[hold]'
- Kutha 2-6: Ongeza kwa nthanda yove
- Kutha 1: Poteza nthanda yove na nthanda ipwe
- Hold: Ongeza nthanda yove kwa oscore yove na nthanda ipwe
- Ya kwanza kufikia {winning_score} pointi ukwame

Pa nthanda yove, ove takaona oscore ya pili na nthanda yove.
Yamukula na '[roll]' kutha kana '[hold]' kubanka pointi zove.
